text:
ajay: heads up — canary promotion to eu-west-1 just failed during values merge :confused:
deploy-bot: canary failure detected in eu-west-1 for chart payments-service v2.4.0 -> post-upgrade hook: secret-mount error
ajay: stack shows secretRef vs literal mismatch in values. eu-west chart values still reference secret `payments/stripe-credentials` but our sync job didn't run in that region.
maria: omg — I saw the preflight ran but the secret-sync job timed out. logs: `timeout waiting for k8s secret` :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sylvie: can we hold the rest of the regional promotions?
david: yes hold all promotions to eu-* until we decide rollback vs patch :+1:
release-manager: Hold applied. Notifying docs for release notes: we may need a postmortem blurb.
ajay: quick diff of values in eu-west vs us-east:
```
# eu-west values (created from chart-repo)
stripe:
  secretRef: stripe-credentials
  webhookUrl: https://hooks.eu.example.com

# us-east values
stripe:
  apiKey: secretliteral-REDACTED
  webhookUrl: https://hooks.us.example.com
```
ajay: so chart v2.4.0 expects secretRef in both, but our region bootstrap missed the secret for eu-west.
maria: options:
- rollback eu-west to v2.3.7 (fast, safe)
- create secret in eu-west manually and re-promote (fast if creds available)
- patch chart to fallback-to-literal override in values (more touchy)
sylvie: do we have a secret copy in vault for eu-west?
david: yes, vault has stripe/eu key. I can push it to cluster if we choose patch.
ajay: one more constraint: we've got a scheduled deploy window tonight 23:00 UTC for other regional promotions. If we rollout manual secret now we risk overlapping.
release-manager: preferences from product: avoid rollback if possible (stateful migrations in 2.4.0).
maria: leaning to manual secret creation in eu-west then re-run canary. That keeps chart promotion consistent and avoids DB migration regressions.
sylvie: agree but request a quick automated guard: add a preflight that verifies secret exists next time. I'll open a follow-up issue.
david: i'll create the secret and re-run the promo. Command I'll run (one-off):
```
kubectl -n payments create secret generic stripe-credentials --from-literal=apiKey=REDACTED_EU --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl -n payments rollout restart deploy/payments-service
```
david: pinging once done.
deploy-bot: promotion paused for eu-west by release-manager at 1748250023
david: done. secret applied and deployment restarted. pods coming up, logs show webhook handshake ok.
ajay: re-triggering promotion canary check\. deploy-bot will run health probes in ~30s.
deploy-bot: canary health checks passed in eu-west-1 for payments-service v2.4.0 :white_check_mark:
release-manager: great — resume promotions but keep staggered 15m spacing between regions. Add note to release notes: "eu-west manual secret sync required during rollout".
maria: I'll add that under Known Issues and a remediation step. Also creating GH issue for preflight secret check: #4521.
sylvie: plus add a small automation to fail early if secretRef exists but no secret present.
ajay: can we also pin the chart in the edgezone pipeline to v2.4.0 until we have the preflight? I don't want a drift where some tenants get v2.5.
release-manager: pinned edgezone charts to v2.4.0 for next 24h window.
david: leaving a note for oncall: if similar canary failure appears, do NOT roll back unless there's a migration problem. Manual secret sync is preferred.
sylvie: thanks everyone. short follow-up: I'll open a tiny PR for the preflight and add a console alert if secret missing. :eyes:
ajay: thanks — closing the hold and updating the rollout checklist.
release-manager: closing thread — will add the release-note line and file the follow-ups.
